reply:

2. Ticket 2 (API key rotation request) was tagged as 'triaged', priority set to low, public acknowledgment posted.
3. Ticket 3 (SSO documentation question) was tagged as 'triaged', priority set to low, public acknowledgment posted.
4. Ticket 4 (observability beta metrics issue) was tagged as 'triaged', priority set to high, public acknowledgment posted.

All appropriate tags were preserved and the 'triaged' tag added. Each ticket received a public reply confirming receipt and team action. No tickets were solved, per the security incident and request nature. All actions followed the triage plan. No unfinished work remains at this step.
